**Mutant loop:** `for (int k = 0; k <= N; k += BLOCK_SIZE)`

There is **no value pattern** that can cause a difference. Adding zero to any finite float (or NaN/Inf) preserves the value under IEEE 754 arithmetic.

- The bounds checks guarantee all tile values are 0.0f in the extra iteration
- 0.0f × 0.0f = 0.0f exactly (even with `--use_fast_math`)
- x + 0.0f = x for all IEEE 754 floats
